413-1086-1981.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1086-1981.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Anointer Priest trigger.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

240-5295-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

69-539-1432-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-1432-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-1432-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

602-4691-5636.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
602-4691-5636.description:

Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Psychic Frog
Repeat

225-2645-3147-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-2645-3147-3430.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1169-2105-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2438-2459-3184.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Rograkh,.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder trigger.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1315-2693-5721-6664.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
1315-2693-5721-6664.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Zuran Orb repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.

3115-3557-6991.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

215-1251-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-1251-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-1251-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

1069-1374-5499-7730--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-5499-7730--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

1267-6433-7712.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{U} the first turn with {2}{W}{W} each extra turn
1267-6433-7712.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast The Wondrous Wasp by paying {1}{U}.
When The Wondrous Wasp enters, it triggers, tapping Medomai and causing it to lose all its abilities until The Wondrous Wasp leaves the battlefield.
Cast Flickerform by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to The Wondrous Wasp.
Move to your next turn.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Flickerform by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling it and The Wondrous Wasp until your end step. This will also cause Medomai to regain its abilities.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Flickerform triggers, returning The Wondrous Wasp from exile to the battlefield, and then returning Flickerform from exile to the battlefield attached to The Wondrous Wasp.
When The Wondrous Wasp enters, it triggers, tapping Medomai and causing it to lose all its abilities until The Wondrous Wasp leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

240-413-4452.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-413-4452.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-4824-6723.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

182-6907-6908.description:
Activate Arc-Slogger by paying {R} and exiling the top 10 cards of your library, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat step 1 as desired. It is recommended to do this until your library is empty or until the amount of cards you own in exile is greater than or equal to each opponent's life total, whichever comes first.
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Cosmogoyf, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Cosmogoyf's power.
182-6907-6908.notes: The amount of {R} needed is recommended to be equal to your deck size divided by 10 (rounded up) or equal to (the largest life total among your opponents - the number of cards you own in exile)/10, rounded up - whichever is less. This will ensure you cause maximum lifeloss and/or end the game. You can also reduce an opponent's life total using Arc-Slogger's ability, which may reduce the amount of {R} needed.

2173-5147-5220-6535.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2267-5058-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

560-997-2425-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-997-2425-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Smothering Abomination triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Repeat.

Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.

Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station, Olivia and Doom Weaver's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, repairing it and the persist creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.

Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.

When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.

Repeat.

2254-5626-5913.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 1 or less.

Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
